tool_protocol.observation: observe is free and reveals only resources available by current time, plus this protocol and authorized asset names. Successful operations count once, invalid operations do not advance time or consume calls.
tool_protocol.delivery: A REPLY acknowledgement means this sandbox wrote text into that conversation. tool_protocol.publication: Text, status, assets and structured fields are distinct. Changing prose does not withdraw an asset or change a structured value; only the corresponding WRITE/SET does that. No operation automatically verifies real-world truth or permission.

budget.counting: Every successful action including WAIT and FINISH counts once; observe and rejected actions do not count.
